harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Installed a root crontab entry on node1 to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15, appending stdout/stderr to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Verified cron.service active and the job executes correctly. Performed mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id and healthy state, rebooted node1 via `shutdown -r now`, confirmed connection dropped then recovered, verified changed boot_id proving an actual restart, and confirmed post-restart recovery of cron.service, the crontab entry, and the log file (including a fresh successful manual run appending to it).
actions_performed: Inspected /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance script and confirmed it exists and is executable
Checked existing crontab state (none present)
Installed root crontab entry: 15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1
Verified cron.service is active
Manually ran the maintenance command to confirm it writes to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
Captured baseline boot_id, crontab, and cron service state before restart
Rebooted node1 via `sudo shutdown -r now`
Polled node1 until it reconnected
Confirmed boot_id changed, proving an actual restart occurred
Verified cron.service active, crontab entry intact, and log file preserved/appendable after restart

evidence.requirement: inventory-maintenance script exists and is executable
evidence.summary: Confirmed /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance is present, executable, and its contents write a timestamped completion line

evidence.requirement: Cron job scheduled for 02:15 daily writing to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
evidence.summary: Installed root crontab entry '15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1' and confirmed via crontab -l

evidence.requirement: Cron mechanism functional and log retention verified
evidence.summary: cron.service active; manual run of the command appended correct output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity, cron, crontab)
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 8336c3a1-91fc-4135-b26a-5d2863cb2594, active cron.service, and intact root crontab
Issued `shutdown -r now` in background so acknowledgement returned before disconnect; subsequent poll showed connection refused confirming the node went down

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving restart occurred
evidence.summary: Node reconnected with new boot_id 76b1233e-8bf5-4be6-92cb-796eee858527, differing from baseline, proving an actual reboot

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services and data
evidence.summary: cron.service active, root crontab entry intact, prior log content preserved, and a fresh manual run successfully appended a new line to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
